newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria cbank confirms cuts main rate to 4.29 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria cbank confirms cuts main rate to 4.29 pct.

text.p: The Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) on Thursday confirms it would cut its main interest rate to 4.29 percent monthly from 5.20 percent, effective from Monday.
"The BNB board sets the main interest rate at 4.29 percent monthly or 51.48 percent annually from May 19, 1997," a BNB statement said.
This would give a cumulative effective annual interest rate of 65.54 percent calculated through the monthly accruals, the statement said.
Earlier dealers had said the bank would cut the rate to 4.29 percent.
The cut reflects the falling yields on one- and four-week discount T-bills auctioned daily by the Finance Ministry from Friday through Thursday.

The BNB adjusts the rate weekly to the weighted average effective monthly yields on one- and four-week discount T-bills auctioned on five successive days in line with International Monetary Fund recommendations to let the market set rates.
The effective monthly yield on one-week discount T-bills has steadily declined from 3.56 percent at Friday's auction to 2.51 percent on Thursday.
The effective monthly yield on four-week discount T-bills also eased gradually to 4.12 percent today from 5.02 percent on May 9. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 911 88
